name: vn.since98/zalo-business-reference
title: Zalo Business Reference (ZBS Template Message, OA)
description: ZBS (ZNS) message prices, OA plans, template checks, sending rules and Zalo error codes. Unofficial.

tools.name: estimate_message_cost
tools.description: Estimate what Zalo charges for ZBS template messages (formerly ZNS): base price by template type (otp, voucher, payment_request, bus_ticket, custom = "other types", rating, quick_response, carousel, journey "from" price) for phone or UID sending, plus buttons by category (the first button to the OA page/Mini App/OA article and the first to an e-invoice page are free, others paid from the first), image module and quick reply. Returns the price per message with a line breakdown, the total if all messages are delivered, the estimate for delivery_rate (only delivered messages are charged), totals with VAT if you pass vat_rate (Zalo names no rate), the OA plan needed to send through the API, and days needed at the daily quota (default 20000, a new OA). OTP, quick response, journey and carousel by UID are rejected. Prices exclude VAT. Reference only, no messages are sent. Examples: {"template_type":"custom","buttons":["business_website"],"count":10000}; {"template_type":"custom","delivery":"uid","buttons":["oa_profile_page"],"count":5000,"delivery_rate":0.9,"vat_rate":0.1}; {"template_type":"otp","count":20000}.

template_type.description: ZBS template type: otp, payment_request, voucher, bus_ticket, custom (the "other types" row: order status, reminders, notices), rating, quick_response, carousel, journey (special industries, price "from"). Default custom.

delivery.description: How messages are addressed: "phone" (phone number, default) or "uid" (Zalo user ID for this OA; cheaper, not for OTP, quick response, journey or carousel).

buttons.description: Extra buttons by category, one item per button (repeat a category for two buttons): oa_profile_page, business_mini_app, oa_article_or_other_zalo_asset, e_invoice_lookup, business_website, call_phone, business_app_page, other_website_or_mini_app, other_app_page, app_download_landing. The first button to the OA page / business Mini App / OA article (one category) and the first to an e-invoice page are free; others are paid from the first. Built-in type buttons (copy code, transfer, details) are free and not listed here.

image.description: Image module (1-3 images) included. Default false. Not allowed on OTP.

quick_reply.description: Quick reply (response) buttons activated. Default false; always on for quick_response.

delivery_rate.description: Expected share of messages that get delivered and charged, 0-1 (default 1 = all). Only delivered messages are charged.

vat_rate.description: Optional VAT rate as a share (e.g. 0.1) to add to the totals. Zalo's ZBS page says prices exclude VAT but names no rate, so the rate is yours.

quota_level.description: OA daily quota level for template messages: 1000, 5000, 20000, 50000, unlimited (default 20000, where a new OA starts; 1000 and 5000 are penalty levels).

tools.name: oa_plan_compare
tools.description: Compare the Zalo Official Account plans in force from 1 June 2026 (Cơ bản, Tiêu chuẩn, Tăng trưởng, Toàn diện) with prices including 10% VAT, staff accounts, Open API and its requests-per-minute limit, consultation messages outside the 48-hour window and features, and pick the smallest plan that meets your needs (needs_api, api_requests_per_minute, replies_outside_48h_per_month, staff, features, term_months 6 or 12), with the reason and the paid-reply overage. The Cơ bản price is not published by Zalo. Reference only. Examples: {}; {"needs_api":true,"staff":8}; {"replies_outside_48h_per_month":3000,"features":["chatbot"],"term_months":6}.

needs_api.description: The OA needs the Open API (for integrations or sending template messages through the API). Default false.

api_requests_per_minute.description: Peak OA API requests per minute (implies needs_api when above 0).

replies_outside_48h_per_month.description: Consultation messages per month sent more than 48 hours after the user's last interaction (paid replies).

staff.description: Staff accounts that will work in the OA. Default 1.

features.description: Required features: chat_basic, chat_advanced_labels_assign_notes, group_chat_gmf, voice_call_basic, voice_call_advanced, mobile_chat_tool, basic_automation, chat_menu, chatbot, extensions, articles_comments_campaign_tool, advanced_reports_activity_log_crm, search_in_zalo_share_qr, follow_invitations, custom_url_priority_features_priority_support.

term_months.description: Plan term: 12 (default) or 6 months (6 months only for Tăng trưởng and Toàn diện).

tools.name: validate_template
tools.description: Check a ZBS template draft against the formal technical rules Zalo publishes: template name, title and text block lengths and parameter counts, table rows and cell lengths, number of buttons (2 vs 3 conflict reported as a warning), button text and URL length, parameters only in the URL path, one OA page button, logo PNG 400x96, image module 1-3 images 16:9 up to 500 KB, parameter types and sample lengths, and formal content hints (links or phone numbers in the text, icons, "anh/chị", superlatives in Tag 3). Types: custom, otp, rating, quick_response. Returns errors and warnings with the rule and the official page. Content is reviewed by Zalo, not here; the text is not stored. Example: {"template_type":"custom","tag":1,"title":"Order <order_code> confirmed","paragraphs":["Hello <customer_name>, your order <order_code> is on its way."],"buttons":[{"category":"business_website","text":"Track order","url":"https://shop.example.vn/track/<order_code>"}],"logo":{"format":"PNG","width":400,"height":96}}.

template_type.description: Template to check: custom (default), otp, rating, quick_response.

tag.description: Template tag: 1 transaction, 2 customer care, 3 promotion.

name.description: Template name (visible only to the business).

paragraphs.description: Text blocks (custom: 1-4; OTP and rating: one).

category.description: Button category (to check the one-OA-page-button rule).

url.description: Button link; parameters like <order_id> only in the path.

phone.description: Call button number: fixed or one phone_number parameter.

logo.description: Logo file facts: format (PNG), width and height in px.

images.description: Image module files: width, height (px), size_kb.

params.description: Declared parameters: name, Zalo type (customer_name, phone_number, address, code, custom_label, transaction_status, contact, personal_title, product_name, amount, time, bank_transfer_note, url_in_button, otp) and an optional sample value.

tools.name: check_sending_rules
tools.description: Check whether a ZBS template send is allowed: the sending window by tag in Vietnam time (Tag 1 round the clock, Tag 2 and 3 07:00-22:00; for Tag 1 at night a warning notes the -133 wording; the conflicting announcement dates are named), the OA daily quota (levels 1000, 5000, 20000, 50000, unlimited; default 20000), Tag 3 limits per user (1 per day, 30 per month), and the quota upgrade conditions (Good quality over 7 days and 2 x the daily quota sent in 7 days). Reference only, nothing is sent. Examples: {"tag":3,"send_time":"21:30","daily_volume":15000}; {"tag":2,"send_time":"06:30"}; {"tag":3,"promo_sent_to_user_today":1}; {"tag":1,"quota_level":20000,"sent_last_7_days":45000}.

tag.description: Template tag: 1 transaction, 2 customer care, 3 promotion.

send_time.description: Planned send time, HH:MM in Vietnam time (UTC+7).

daily_volume.description: Template messages the OA plans to send that day (all templates).

quota_level.description: OA daily quota level for template messages: 1000, 5000, 20000, 50000, unlimited (default 20000, where a new OA starts; 1000 and 5000 are penalty levels).

promo_sent_to_user_today.description: Tag 3 messages this OA has already sent to the same user today (before this one).

promo_sent_to_user_this_month.description: Tag 3 messages this OA has already sent to the same user this month (before this one).

sent_last_7_days.description: Messages sent successfully in the last 7 days (to check the quota upgrade volume condition).

delivery.description: How messages are addressed: "phone" (phone number, default) or "uid" (Zalo user ID for this OA; cheaper, not for OTP, quick response, journey or carousel).

tools.name: choose_channel
tools.description: Suggest which Zalo channel fits a business task, by simple published rules: ZBS template message (with the template type, tag, price and window), a free consultation reply within 48 hours of the user's last interaction (paid outside 48 hours, not allowed after 7 days), an OA broadcast to followers, or a Mini App. Tasks: otp, order_status, delivery_tracking, payment_request, appointment_reminder, customer_reply, service_rating, promotion, voucher, birthday_greeting, news_to_followers, catalog_checkout. Optional: last_interaction_hours, is_follower. Reference only. Examples: {"task":"order_status"}; {"task":"customer_reply","last_interaction_hours":30}; {"task":"promotion","is_follower":true}.

task.description: What you need to send: otp, order_status, delivery_tracking, payment_request, appointment_reminder, customer_reply, service_rating, promotion, voucher, birthday_greeting, news_to_followers, catalog_checkout.

last_interaction_hours.description: Hours since the user's last interaction with the OA (message, call, menu tap...). Decides whether a free reply is possible.

tools.name: error_lookup
tools.description: Explain a Zalo error code in plain words: which table it comes from (ZBS Template Message, the archived ZNS table, or the Official Account API; the same code can mean different things in different tables) and what to check. A positive number is also tried as negative. Examples: {"code":-133}; {"code":-100,"table":"oa_api"}; {"code":249}.

code.description: Error code returned by Zalo, e.g. -133 (a positive number is also tried as negative).

table.description: Limit to one table: zbs (ZBS Template Message), zns_archive (old ZNS), oa_api (Official Account API).

tools.name: data_info
tools.description: Return the data version and retrieval date, the official Zalo pages used, what Zalo does not publish (Cơ bản plan price, broadcast price above the free allowance, Mini App fees, the VAT rate for template messages, and others), where Zalo's own pages disagree (maximum buttons, night window, OTP by UID, old fallback prices) and how this tool resolves it, the change log and the worked example. Use when the user asks how current or reliable the figures are. Takes no arguments: {}.
